text:
sam_cs: Heads-upLuminaLabs kickoff in 2 hours. They asked for a tiny field kit: 1) a non-technical one-pager for PMs about caching/batching/streaming, and 2) a single-page engineer snippet and quick troubleshooting commands. Goal: minimize renewal risk first 7 days.

nina_csm: I'll draft the PM one-pager. Can we give three preset profiles (conservative / balanced / performance) with concrete numbers they can paste? PMs love those.

leo_sre: Yes. Engineer defaults I recommend: conservative: ttl=45s, batch=8; balanced: ttl=150s, batch=16; performance: ttl=600s, batch=32 (GPU). Streaming: chunk=128 tokens, stream_window_ms=80. KV cache: 64MB (small customers) / 128MB (mid). Note: enable warm-pool for 48h.

jo_support: For the PM doc, translate numbers into quick guidance: conservative = low risk, better for variable prompts; performance = best if you can prime requests/warm caches. Add a renewal-risk trigger: if p95 > 350ms or cache hit% < 25% by Day3, escalate.

leo_sre: Paste engineer snippet (single JSON block they can copy):
```json
{"cache":{"strategy":"prefix","ttl_s":150,"kv_mb":128},"batching":{"max_batch_gpu":32,"max_batch_cpu":8,"batch_timeout_ms":20},"streaming":{"chunk_tokens":128,"stream_window_ms":80},"slo":{"p95_ms":200,"fallback_sync_after_ms":300}}
```

leo_sre: Quick commands for triage:
```
# cache hit last 24h
redwoodctl metrics query --customer luminalabs --metric cache_hit_ratio --window 24h

# p95 and errors
redwoodctl metrics query --customer luminalabs --metric p95_latency,error_rate --window 24h

# tail stream errors
redwoodctl logs tail --customer luminalabs --filter "stream_error" --since 1h
```

jo_support: Ops playbook (short): 1) Day0 smoke (Support) - run 5 sample prompts end-to-end and confirm partial streaming tokens appear; 2) Day1 prime (CS) - send 8 representative prompts per heavy user; 3) Day3 review (CS+SRE) - p95, errors, cache_hit; 4) Day7 renewal-check (CS+AE) - if signals flagged, prepare tuning plan.

nina_csm: I'll include a 3-question Day7 feedback snippet for PMs to send to product teams: 1) Are outputs meeting expectations? (yes/no), 2) Any responses >500ms? (yes/no + example), 3) Any streaming artifacts? (yes/no). We'll capture replies into our CS dashboard.

ops-bot: scheduled task: "prefill-top-keys" for luminalabs at 2025-06-14T09:00:00Z :gear:

sam_cs: Owners: Nina = PM one-pager + email template, Leo = engineer snippet + triage commands, Jo = run Day0 and Day3 checks. I'll coordinate Day7 renewal check with AE.

jo_support: Running Day0 smoke at 09:30 PT, will report back here with results.

sam_cs: Nice work team. Saving this thread and will upload docs to the customer folder. If anyone has edge-case notes (very short chatty prompts, heavy streaming UI), post them here before EOD. :white_check_mark:
